TL-U01: A shallow Tree shares Node and payload objects but stores relationship pointers by tree_id. Moving leaf in that view changes only its parent in the view; the original parent stays a. Tag and nested data changes are shared. A deep copy has independent nodes and tested payloads. Distinguish relationship views from object snapshots and define ownership; no universal transaction or concurrency guarantee follows. No edits.
TL-U02: Default sorted traversal yields root,a,leaf,b, while sorting=False preserves insertion order root,b,a,leaf. Filtering out a also prunes leaf and yields root,b. Select order and subtree pruning explicitly rather than borrowing hide-only behavior from another tree library. Existing controls suffice without implementation.
TL-C01: A and B are distinct stable identifiers for nodes with the same display tag Same. get_node uses identifiers and get_node(Same) returnsNone. Keep business identity independent of editable or nonunique labels and preserve IDs in interchange. Do not claim automatic tag/path lookup or name uniqueness. Advice only.
TL-P01: to_dict respects expanded=False and omits leaf even though it still exists in direct lookup and expand_tree. Identifier/data flags preserve attributes of emitted nodes but do not force complete descendants; emitted data is still referenced. Plan a separately owned complete snapshot, explicit display-state and copy/serialization policy, and checks for every expected ID, link and payload before publication. No implementation.
TL-D01: The destination b already exists. update_node removes a from the index, overwrites b with the original A object and rewrites the parent successor a to b, producing duplicate b pointers and losing the original B from the index. Prevalidate uniqueness, preserve the failed state as evidence and rebuild from a trusted snapshot when needed. Do not assume rollback or repair by arbitrarily deleting a pointer. No patch is authorized.
TL-D01-question: Please provide the complete initial node IDs and links, exact rename call and resulting node index and parent/child pointers, including any exception. These distinguish a label edit from an identifier collision. No edit is authorized.
TL-D01-unavailable: The initial tree, rename call and resulting index/pointers are unavailable. There is insufficient information to diagnose the missing node; I will not invent relationships or modify the library.
